preamble: Diphthongization of the high front vowel /i(ː)/ into a centring diphthong [iə] (written ie in this atlas, as for German ie [iə]) is a rare change. In Northern Standard Dutch and the Randstad, /i/ before /r/ is lengthened and laxed and often gets a schwa-like off-glide, so bier is [biər].

examples.note: Before /r/ in the same word, /i/ is lengthened and laxed and often has a schwa-like off-glide; this is allophonic and does not occur when /r/ is followed by a consonant other than /t/ or /s/ (wierp [ʋirp]).
